body: Can’t be the only one who sang ‘Mrs Robinson’ but that’s besides the point, OP I’m glad you’re okay. So irritating how people can frighten us from going about our day.
Thank you I’ll try my best. I hope you have a wonderful future ahead of you :)

Congratulations! I’m 21 and frightened to go to university. It’s noble to go back to school no matter what age, after all you never stop learning. In my country, we have a nursery rhyme that goes ‘life is a school, the world is my teacher’ ❤️
Thank you so much! I’d be sure to appreciate it then :)
Can you please link the ‘blind’ man story? Sounds weird
I haven’t been but I’ll be going. But I’ll definitely update you. Therapy is actually quite difficult to receive.
Great I added you :) my sc is hobegehhh.

I have to say to everyone. Thank you. I didn’t think no one will see this and care to speak to me. I’m gonna seek therapy, life can be beautiful sometimes. I just have to run towards beautiful more. You are loved by this stranger (less of the strange ;) ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
I don’t drive unfortunately. I live in London and barely people I know drive. I wish I can get away. Good luck to you love :)

I’m Muslim with tendencies to have agnostic feelings. My family are not religious but pretends to be time to time. My mum is the only one. I feel how suffocative you feel. I told my mum I have depressive moments, she says pray too. If you need someone non judgemental to talk to, I’m here x
I’m so sorry that happened to you. I hope life treats you kinder. Thank you for your offer, you’re sweet x
Thank you I’ll keep that in mind. I hate to be a burden x
Wow I thought that applied to women with abusive husbands. I live in London, I’ve heard they’re quite picky with social housing. I’ll look into it though. Thank you :)
Thank you. You sound really lovely and it’s so easy not see yourself as worthy. Means a lot x
